title: S3
description: Access to an S3 object. Unversioned S3 and s3 also accept legacy bucket/key fields; conflicting legacy and v2 values are rejected when decoded.

bucketName.description: Name of the bucket holding the object.

bucket.description: Legacy bucketName alias, accepted only for unversioned S3 and s3.

key.description: Legacy objectKey alias, accepted only for unversioned S3 and s3.

mediaType.description: Media type of the referenced object.

endpoint.description: Base endpoint of an S3-compatible store; empty targets AWS S3.

usePathStyle.description: Address the bucket in the path instead of the host.
